# Economic Impact Report Template
# ============================================================
# Generated by: Economic Analyst agent
# Saved to: specs/verification/TASK-{N}-economic.md
# ============================================================

task_id: "TASK-{N}"
finding_title: "{brief title}"
analyst: "Economic Analyst"
timestamp: "{YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ}"
rpc_block_number: null   # Set to actual block if on-chain data used

# ── Asset at Risk ─────────────────────────────────────────────

asset:
  name: "{token name}"
  symbol: "{SYMBOL}"
  contract: "{0x...}"
  decimals: 18
  price_usd: 0.00
  price_source: "CoinGecko | Chainlink | TWAP | estimated"

# ── Protocol TVL ─────────────────────────────────────────────

tvl:
  contract: "{0x...}"
  balance_raw: "0"           # raw uint256 from cast call
  balance_human: "0.00"      # balance / decimals
  balance_usd: "$0"
  note: ""

# ── Maximum Extractable Value ────────────────────────────────

mev:
  attack_type: "direct_drain | share_inflation | oracle_manip | flash_loan_amplified | griefing"
  single_tx_max_extract_human: "0.00 TOKEN"
  single_tx_max_extract_usd: "$0"
  multi_tx_max_extract_usd: "$0 (if applicable)"
  calculation: |
    {Show the formula and numbers used, e.g.:}
    max_extract = victim_deposit × (manipulated_price / fair_price - 1)
    = 500,000 × (1.001 / 1.000 - 1)
    = $500

# ── Attack Cost ───────────────────────────────────────────────

attack_cost:
  gas_units: 0                # from PoC forge test output
  gas_price_gwei: 30          # assumed
  gas_cost_eth: "0.000"
  gas_cost_usd: "$0"
  flash_loan_fee: "$0"        # 0.05% of flash loan amount if used
  total_attack_cost_usd: "$0"
  net_profit_usd: "$0"
  economically_rational: true   # net_profit_usd > 0

# ── Capital Requirements ──────────────────────────────────────

capital:
  flash_loan_required: false
  flash_loan_amount: null
  flash_loan_available: null
  token_accumulation_required: false
  token_accumulation_amount: null
  one_tx_permissionless: true
  barrier_assessment: "Low | Medium | High"

# ── Severity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

severity:
  calculated: "Critical | High | Medium | Low | Informational"
  justification: |
    {Which Immunefi matrix criterion applies, e.g.:}
    Direct loss > $500k → Critical
    OR direct loss $50k-$500k → High
  proposed_by_verifier: "Critical | High | Medium | Low | Informational | (none)"
  agreement: true
  disagreement_note: ""   # Populate if agreement = false

impact_class: "theft_of_funds | permanent_freeze | temporary_freeze | griefing | dos"

# ── Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

summary: |
  {2-3 sentences in plain English summarizing the economic impact.
  Suitable for inclusion in the executive report.}

# ── On-Chain Evidence ─────────────────────────────────────────

cast_commands_run:
  - command: "cast call ..."
    output: ""
